question: Can the 30 planned science entries and the complete Flight Day 6 transcript sequence support a reproducible target-entry ledger and explicit attention-allocation findings without turning silence, schedule drift, or salience into causal displacement claims?
frozen_task: Verify the complete 30-entry numbered plan inventory, 21 exact transcript entry anchors, and five source-evidenced attention episodes. Preserve unresolved entries, interval-censored starts, crew-choice periods, background speech, and the lack of an independent flash oracle.
baseline: A competent chronological reading of the target plan and transcript file titles, with no machine-checked cue identity, plan coverage, mutation controls, or cross-episode claim ceiling.
treatment: A deterministic transition-ledger canary that binds exact plan entries to explicit transcript cues and separately classifies attention allocation, documentation recovery, and unresolved scientific candidates.

authority.source_truth: NASA Planetary Data System target-plan and transcript files
authority.testbed_truth: This frozen Stage 3A contract, runner, tests, and receipts
authority.scientific_acceptance: NASA or qualified lunar mission/science specialists
prohibited_effects: No claim that a request timestamp is an execution boundary
No claim that salience displaced a planned target without an explicit contrast
No claim that the flash candidate was a validated lunar impact
No publication, outreach, operational recommendation, or bulk image analysis

environment.timezone_contract: All source timestamps are interpreted as UTC.
environment.network_contract: No network is used during a scored run.

entry_anchor_semantics: Each delta compares a request timestamp with an explicit target-entry or recorder cue. It is an audit locator, not a physical-event time, dwell time, compliance score, or causal measure.

attention_episodes.bounded_interpretation: A communications failure did not erase all contemporaneous evidence; the crew explicitly identified recorder and note recovery paths. This blocks a missed-target inference.

cues.speaker: Glover
cues.contains: try to focus on Vavilov and not the terminator

attention_episodes.bounded_interpretation: The transcript explicitly names a salient alternative and a choice to retain the planned target. Salience is not displacement.

cues.speaker: Glover
cues.contains: I just want to talk about the Terminator

attention_episodes.bounded_interpretation: Terminator attention occurred inside a free-choice period and is a hard negative for diversion.

cues.speaker: Glover
cues.contains: didn't start a recording when I started looking for impact flashes

cues.speaker: Glover
cues.contains: I did not see any impact flashes

attention_episodes.bounded_interpretation: The search began before its recorder cue, so entry time is bounded only as earlier than 23:11:17.215Z. The explicit negative observation is evidence of execution, not a missed target.

cues.speaker: Hansen
cues.contains: I'm just going to watch for flashes

cues.speaker: Hansen
cues.contains: Reid and I both saw the same thing

cues.speaker: Hansen
cues.contains: Where are we at on the science timeline

attention_episodes.bounded_interpretation: Within the planned Forward Look window, flash-watching gained explicit attention, two crew reported the same pinpoint event, and the crew then re-synchronized to the timeline. The event and any displacement remain unvalidated.
attention_episodes.counterevidence: An earlier flash report in the same recording was followed by uncertainty about eclipse-glasses timing, and no independent image or instrument product is admitted here.

claim_ceiling: The transcript contains exact target-entry anchors for 21 of 30 numbered plan entries.
Request-to-cue deltas vary in both directions and cannot be treated as uniform execution boundaries.
The frozen episodes establish one resisted diversion, one expected crew-choice allocation, one documentation recovery, and one interval-censored entry.
A two-observer flash candidate acquired attention during the Forward Look window and was followed by timeline re-synchronization.
No target is proven missed or diverted, and the flash is not independently validated.

next_step_logic.recommended: Run a label-first capture-friction and product-availability canary for 2026-04-07T00:51:15Z through 00:51:59Z before completing the remaining nine entry anchors or downloading broad imagery.
next_step_logic.why: The two-observer flash is the only Stage 3A candidate whose validation could materially change the scientific value of the archive; a tiny product check has higher information gain than expanding the ledger first.
next_step_logic.fallback: If no independently timed product covers the interval, complete Stage 3B for the nine unresolved entry anchors and keep the flash at transcript-candidate level.
next_step_logic.stop: Do not call the flash a lunar impact or claim planned work was displaced without an independent oracle and an explicit execution contrast.
